title: Caravan to Vaccarès
writer: Alistair MacLean, Paul Wheeler, Joseph Forest
actors: David Birney, Charlotte Rampling, Michael Lonsdale
plot: Neil Bowman, meets Lila, a British photographer, in France. They're hired to escort a Hungarian scientist to New York by French landowner Duc de Croyter but face a gang of ruthless kidnappers after the scientist.
